statements.t: With improving end market conditions and momentum accelerating across the combined company, we are raising our full year 2026 revenue guidance by $43 million at the midpoint and our fourth quarter guidance calls for double digit growth in both our organic and acquired businesses on a days adjusted basis.”
The Company is raising its full-year 2026 organic constant currency revenue growth guidance to the range of 9.1% to 9.7%.
The Company is raising its acquired business revenue expectation and now expects full-year 2026 acquired business reported revenue of approximately $3.050 billion on an owned-period basis.

The Company is updating its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to the range of $14.60 to $14.70, which represents 11% to 12% year-over-year adjusted EPS growth and is 13% to 14% on a constant currency basis.
The Company expects fourth quarter 2026 organic constant currency revenue growth to be in the range of 7.0% to 9.0%.
The Company expects acquired business reported revenue for the fourth quarter of 2026 to be approximately $817 million.
The Company expects fourth quarter 2026 adjusted EPS to be in the range of $4.58 to $4.68, which represents 1% to 3% year-over-year adjusted EPS growth.
The acquisition complements Waters’ industry-leading mass spectrometry portfolio and is expected to broaden the Company’s entry into the proteomics market.
The Company is unable to provide reconciliations of forward-looking presentations of adjusted EPS guidance measures to the most directly comparable GAAP measures.

Because non-GAAP financial measures exclude the effect of items that will increase or decrease the Company’s reported results of operations, management strongly encourages investors to review the Company’s consolidated financial statements and publicly filed reports in their entirety.
